CASTING & INQUIRIES Season 05 Submissions

Guest Application

We invite licensed clinicians, somatic researchers, memoirists, and courageous individuals with lived experience to sit across from Maya and Marcus in Seattle or via remote high-fidelity audio link.

Our Recording Safety Contract With Every Guest

01

No Ambush Questions

We provide full thematic roadmaps in advance. You will never be blindsided on tape.

02

Full Pause Authority

You can pause the recording or request a sensory break at any point during the session.

03

Post-Tape Retraction

If you share something vulnerable that you later wish kept private, we cut it without question.

Our production desk reviews casting applications on a rolling basis. Thank you for your vulnerability.
